description: This file declares an interface IEventHandler within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, defining callback methods for container state events.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: Interface declaring callback methods for container lifecycle events such as start, stop, fail, and state change.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container has started.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container has stopped.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container has failed.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container's state changes.
